posts.cooked:
You are Nightmist and are opening a gate to other realities. Your goal is to bring forth the most powerful heroes to defend the earth.

Rules:

Pick 2 Heroes. Make a new deck of 40 cards with cards from both Hero decks. Create a new Character card with Name, HP and Power for that Hero. Whenever a card refers to one of the 2 Heroes instead it's treated as the New Hero name. You can choose one of the 'shown' combined Heroes (or select any combination), but you can't combine one Hero and one Villain. Balance is optional. The deck needs to have 40 cards. When including a card you should include all copies of that card in the deck and can only break that rule once to get exactly 40 cards in deck. Hero bio is optional.

The 'shown' combined-heroes here are:

SkyScrapper+Tempest
Parse+Captain Cosmic
Lucky Strike: Setback+Legacy
Cold War: Bunker+Absolute Zero

The hero+Villain, not selectable:
Fanatic+Apostate
Chrono Ranger+¿La Capitan?
Akash Bhuta+¿Argent/Naturalist?


I'll start with one

Revenge
Time travel creates ripples in reality, like a pebble thrown in a quiet pond. From these ripples, 'pocket' realities are created and destroy. From one of these, Revenge emerged before it collapsed on itself. His goal: to protect his new home and hunt down every super powered being that threatens it.
Chrono Ranger+Expatriette
HP: 27
Time warp
Power: Reveal the bottom card of your deck. If it's a Chrono Ranger card, put it into play, otherwise discard it.

Cards
Chrono Ranger:
Bounties x5
Sudden Contract x4
Jim's Hat x1
Displaced Armory x4
Eye on the Prize x4
Terrible Tech-Strike x2

Expat
Tactical Shotgun x3
Assault Rifle x3
Submachine Gun x3
Hollow Points x2
Incendiary Rounds x2
Liquid Nitroget Rounds x2
RPG Launcher x3
Unload x2

(there are 2 copies of Terrible Tech-Strike in Chrono's deck)


PS: Fixer utterly broken in any kind of combination

posts.cooked:
I don't know how the forums feel about reviving old posts but this seemed like a fun way to burn off some of my OblivAeon hype.

Fanatic X Wraith

Gargoyle

Alias: Helena Adrianna Montgomery

Height: 5'10"

Wight: 175 lbs

Hair Color: Black

Eye Color: Brown

Birthplace: Unknown

Power Source: Technology & Divine

Group Affiliation: The Liberty Wardens

First Appearance: Darkwatch 18 (but not really cause homebrew)

During a vacation in Peru Daniel Montgomery saw a young girl who'd been playing hit by a bus. He rushed her to the Doctor and thanks to his quick action they were able to keep the girl alive. However, when she awoke she was unable to remember anything. Daniel decided to take the young girl home with him and named her Helena Adrianna Montgomery. After the loss of his wife and infant child many years earlier Daniel had gone deep into mourning. However, Helena's hopeful charm and youthful exuberance soon revitalized the man. One night Daniel heard his daughter awaken, he ran to her room expecting a nightmare only to find tears of joy streaming down her face. The girl claimed she had seen heaven & that god had a purpose for her. "Maybe you can help this city then Helena, Like a Gargoyle standing watch in the darkness." Thus was a hero born. When Helena's wings began to grow in she wanted to begin fighting crime immediately. First however Daniel insisted on using the family's wealth to outfit his daughter with the best training, education and gear money could buy. Now fully ready, Gargoyle's Angelic form, Focused mind, and Strong faith give her a real opportunity to help Rook City. and a massive arsenal of high tech gadgets doesn't hurt either.

 

Gargoyle

HP: 28

Power: Last Shadow: Reduce the next Damage dealt to Gargoyle by 1 and Increase the next Melee damage dealt by her by 1

Cards:

Fanatic

Final Dive x3 

Undaunted x2

Sanctifying Strike x2

Prayer of Desperation x2

Smite the Transgressor x3

Zealous Offense x2

Consecrated Ground x2

Holy Nova x3

Wraith

Micro Targeting Computer x3

Razor Ordinance x3

Stun Bolt x3

Throwing Knives x3

Utility Belt x3

Trust Fund x3

Combat Stance x2

Inventory Barrage x1

posts.name: FrivYeti
posts.cooked:
Ephemeral

(Guise + Parse)

When Kim Powell was dragged through the Realm of Discord by a failed Revocorp experiment, she studied and drew the powers of the chaotic land to herself, twisting and warping her nature until she was barely real. Now, the constantly-shifting Ephemeral tries to safeguard the world, while holding onto her form enough to save herself...

Power: Instability. Draw a card or play a card. Discard a card or Ephemeral deals herself 1 Infernal damage. 

 

DECK:
 

One-Shot:

* Best Card Ever! (x2)
* Gimmicky Character (x3)
* Retcon (x3)
* Where Did I Leave That (x3)
* Impossible Shot (x3)
* Recompile (x3)
* Syntactic Analysis (x2)

Ongoing:
* Critical Multiplier (x3)
* Reveal The Flaws (x2)
* Buffer Overflow (x2)
* Segmentation Fault (x2)
* Gauge (x2)

Ongoing, Limited:
* Blatant Reference (x2)
* Gritty Reboot (x2)
* Selling Out (x2)
* Total Beefcake (x2)
* Snap Decision (x2)

Playstyle Notes: This takes Guise's propensity for short-duration Ongoings, and Parse's tendency towards draw/discard, and merges them into a constantly-shifting board and game. It's low on direct damage, but with a lot of destruction and ways to buff your allies or cause trouble. The power also merges the two play styles; it uses Guise's draw/discard, and then applies a penalty that can be turned into an advantage in one of two ways.
